create_compile_lock_manager: create a CompileLockManager instance with a config hash to manage file-based compilation locks
build_config_hash: build a config hash string from vLLM model parameters for lock identification
test_cache_exists: test if a compilation cache already exists by checking the .done marker file
run_acquire_lock: run acquire to get an exclusive compilation lock, returning True if compilation is needed
review_mark_complete: review mark_complete to create the .done marker file signaling compilation finished
